members.name: A Trace of Days Gone By · Fia

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Phantom Dust. The targets of this skill become the 3 enemies with the highest ATK.
Strengthens A Revelation Transcribed. The amount her SPD increases by becomes 30%.
Strengthens Phantom Dust. The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 240% of her ATK.

levels.text:
Her power, said to be capable of destroying the world with only the tip of her finger, was no more. Now, only a vestige of that murderous force remains—
Deals 1 magical attack equal to 160% of Lily’s ATK to the 2 enemies with the highest ATK, and has a 30% chance to inflict [Fainted] on all targets for 1 turn.
The chance to inflict [Fainted] becomes 70%.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 220% of her ATK.

Once she unravels the logic that shapes the matter before her, she returns it to its very foundation—
a particle even smaller than a speck of dust.
Deals 6 magical attacks equal to 160% of Lily’s ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, before dealing the magical attacks, decreases the incoming healing potency of all targets by 40% for 4 turns.
The number of magical attacks becomes 10.
Before dealing the magical attacks, if Lily is enhanced with [Lingering Scent] and its stack count is 20, the magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 320% of her ATK.

“The current me is the trace of my soul left in the flower and Fia’s memories of me, made into one by your staff’s power. In other words, I’m something akin to a ghost.”
At the start of the battle, this skill increases Lily’s chance to inflict a debuff by 15% for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).
The increase in her chance to inflict a debuff becomes 30%.
At the start of the battle, additionally, if the number of allies with the same Soul in Lily’s party is 3 or more, increases her SPD by 10% for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).

The guilt she once abandoned became the very core binding her to the world of the living— Each time Lily or an ally is inflicted with a debuff from an active skill, this skill grants 1 stack of [Lingering Scent] to Lily for each enemy that is inflicted with 1 or more debuffs (20 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled). [Lingering Scent] increases Lily’s ATK by 2% for each stack she is enhanced with.
The targets who are granted [Lingering Scent] become Lily and the ally with the highest ATK.
The targets who are granted [Lingering Scent] become Lily and the 2 allies with the highest ATK.

members.name: The Witch of Lamented Spirits · Elaine

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Heartfelt Embrace. Additionally, after dealing the physical attacks, has a 70% chance to inflict [Enfeeble] on all targets for 2 turns. [Enfeeble] decreases an afflicted target’s ATK after any stat increases or decreases were applied to it by 40%.
Strengthens Power to Warm Hearts. The targets who are granted [Fainted Immunity] become Guinevere and the 2 allies with the highest ATK.
Strengthens Heartfelt Embrace. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 720% of her ATK.

levels.text: With her heart filled with warmth, Guinevere wraps her enemies in a gentle embrace. Guinevere deals damage equal to 20% of her current HP to herself 2 times, and deals 5 physical attacks equal to 280% of her ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attacks, has a 70% chance to increase the damage all targets take by 10% for 2 turns.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 660% of her ATK.

Guinevere uses the overflowing love in her heart to envelop her enemies in warm, inviting hugs. Guinevere deals damage equal to 20% of her current HP to herself
2 times, and deals 3 physical attacks equal to 170% of her ATK to enemies at random.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 340% of her ATK.

Additionally, if Guinevere is enhanced with Lover of All Hearts’ [Increased ATK] buff, the physical attacks’ damage is further increased by 50% of Guinevere’s ATK for each stack of [Increased ATK] she is enhanced with (740% of her ATK max).
The number of physical attacks becomes 5.

With her heart that just can’t get enough of loving or being loved, Guinevere grants her allies power wrapped in warmth. If Guinevere or an ally takes damage via dealing damage to self, this skill grants Guinevere
1 stack of a buff that increases her ATK by 3% (cannot be dispelled). The buff’s stack count is further increased by 1 for each time she or an ally takes damage via dealing damage to self (8 stacks max).
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 6%.
The targets of this skill become Guinevere and the 2 allies with the highest ATK.

“The most I can manage is to warm the hearts of those
I hold close. That’s the extent of my power.” At the start of the battle, this skill increases Guinevere’s SPD by 15% for 4 turns (cannot be dispelled).

Additionally, at the start of Guinevere’s action phase on the 1st turn, if the number of Crimson Soul allies other than Guinevere in the party is 2 or more, grants [Fainted Immunity] to Guinevere for 2 turns.
The amount her SPD increases by becomes 30%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Lakeside Melody. The targets of the physical attack become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens Songstress’s Heart. The decrease in damage she takes becomes 70%.
Strengthens Marche des Petits Oiseaux. The physical attacks’ damage becomes 940%.

levels.text: “Now, surrender your hearts to my song...” Inflicts [Imprison] on Primavera and the ally with the highest ATK for 1 turn. When this skill inflicts [Imprison] on all targets, it ignores Primavera’s chance to inflict a debuff and all targets’ chance to resist a debuff. Afterwards, this skill deals 1 physical attack equal to 320% of Primavera’s ATK to 3 random enemies.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 460% of her ATK.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 680% of her ATK.

“It is time to show off the results of our practice. Now, in time with the rhythm...!” While chirping in harmony, Primavera’s troupe of songbirds dive towards the enemy. Deals 2 physical attacks equal to 480% of Primavera’s ATK to enemies at random.
The number of physical attacks becomes 3.

Additionally, before dealing the initial physical attack, if the total number of debuffs dispelled by Primavera and her allies’ skills during battle is 10 or more, the number of physical attacks becomes 5.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 850% of her ATK.

“Just as flowers are sown in barren soil, I shall sing a song for your hardened hearts...” Her song plants a seed of hope in all who hear it, sowing miracles yet unseen— When Primavera is inflicted with a debuff from an active skill, this skill dispels 1 debuff from her, and grants 1 stack of [Luminous Melody] to her (10 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled). [Luminous Melody] increases Primavera’s ATK by 2% for each stack she is enhanced with.
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 5%.
Additionally, if the debuff that is inflicted on Primavera is an action hindering debuff, the number of stacks of [Luminous Melody] granted by this skill becomes 5.
“I will not let it go again—my symphonic color, the heart of ‘Primavera’...!” Decreases the damage Primavera takes by 30% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally, at the start of the battle, increases her DEF by 90% for 6 turns (cannot be dispelled).

Additionally, if the number of allies with the same Soul as Primavera other than Primavera, or the number of Radiance Soul allies in the party is 2 or more, the amount her DEF increases by becomes 150%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Rending Shimmer. The number of physical attacks becomes 3.
Strengthens Knight of Twilight. The decrease in the damage Florence takes becomes 40%, and the amount her max HP increases by becomes 100%.

Strengthens Rending Shimmer. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 980% of her ATK. If this skill activates on the 7th turn and onwards, the physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1960% of her ATK.

levels.text:
“We will win this battle together!” Restores HP equal to 5% of Florence’s ATK to the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage. “Witness my resolve!” Afterwards, this skill deals 2 physical attacks equal to 520% of Florence’s ATK to enemies at random. If this skill activates on the
7th turn and onwards, this skill’s effect that restores HP to the ally target does not activate, and the physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1040% of Florence’s ATK.
The amount the ally target’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 15% of Florence’s ATK.

The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to
890% of her ATK. If this skill activates on the 7th turn and onwards, the physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1780% of her ATK.

“Scatter into the twilight!” Activates if Florence is enhanced with [Twilight’s Vow]. The rupturing force of her lance sends it tearing through the sunset, raining down the afterglow onto the battlefield. Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 650% of Florence’s ATK to enemies at random.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1050% of her ATK.
The number of physical attacks becomes 6.
Additionally, each time this skill deals a critical hit, the number of attacks it deals increases by 1 (10 total attacks max).

“No matter how far apart we may be, my heart will always remain by your side...” When an active skill of Florence or an ally activates an effect that restores HP, this skill grants Florence 1 stack of a buff that increases both her ATK and chance to deal a critical hit by 1% (10 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled). Starting from the 7th turn, at the start of each turn, if the stack count of this skill’s buff is 10, this skill grants [Twilight’s Vow] to Florence (cannot be dispelled).
The increases in her ATK and chance to deal a critical hit each become 6%.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, increases both her DEF and P. DEF by 100% for 10 turns.

“A vow is a rule one places on themselves. Neither this heart nor this vow will ever waver again. As long as you believe in me...” At the start of the battle, Florence strengthens her basic attack for 10 turns. When she deals a basic attack, she instead deals 1 physical attack equal to 390% of her ATK to 5 random enemies, and afterwards, restores HP to the 3 allies with the lowest remaining HP percentages equal to 10% of their max HP.
At the start of the battle, additionally decreases the damage Florence takes by 10%, and increases her max HP by 20% (cannot be dispelled).

Additionally, before restoring HP, if the remaining HP percentage of a target of HP restoration is 50% or higher, and they are afflicted with an action hindering debuff, all the action hindering debuffs of that target of HP restoration are dispelled.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Prayer of Divine Swords. The amount all ally targets’ DEF increases by becomes equal to 50% of Fortina’s DEF. The amount all ally targets’ P. DEF increases by becomes equal to 50% of Fortina’s P. DEF. The amount all ally targets’ M. DEF increases by becomes equal to 50% of Fortina’s M. DEF.

At the start of the battle, grants 2 layers of [Multi-Barrier] to Fortina (cannot be dispelled). If she takes damage that is equal to 10% or higher of her max HP, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage.
Strengthens Judgement of the Scales. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 610% of her ATK.

levels.text:
“O Lord, please, protect Your servants from harm...!” Increases the DEF of Fortina and all allies whose SPD is higher than Fortina’s SPD by 25% of Fortina’s DEF for
3 turns (cannot be dispelled). Afterwards, this skill
deals 1 physical attack equal to 240% of Fortina’s ATK
to 5 random enemies.

Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, increases the P. DEF of Fortina and all allies whose SPD is higher than Fortina’s SPD by 25% of Fortina’s P. DEF, and their M. DEF by 25% of Fortina’s M. DEF for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled).

The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to
480% of her ATK.

“May all go as God wills...” Those who bear sins must face God’s judgement... Deals 3 physical attacks equal to
410% of Fortina’s ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, after dealing the final physical attack, restores HP equal to 20% of this skill’s total damage to Fortina.
The number of physical attacks becomes 5.

The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to
560% of her ATK.

“Please, always keep my heart close to yours. So that, even when we are apart, our hearts can be as one—” At the start of the battle, if the number of different Souls in Fortina’s party is 2 or less, this skill increases all allies’ SPD by 10% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally, at the start of the 2nd turn, increases the ATK of Fortina and the 2 allies with the highest ATK by 15% of Fortina’s ATK for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled).
The amount Fortina and the 2 allies with the highest ATK’s ATK increases by becomes equal to 30% of Fortina’s ATK.

“We can protect each other... Trust and turn to each other. That’s how I want us to be from now on. So, let me protect you, too—” At the start of Fortina’s action phase on the 1st turn, this skill grants [Devotion] to Fortina for
3 turns (cannot be dispelled). [Devotion] makes Fortina substitutively take 50% of the damage taken by another ally (this damage counts as taking an attack). When Fortina is attacked while she is enhanced with the [Devotion] granted by this skill, the damage is cut by 40%.
When Fortina is attacked while she is enhanced with the [Devotion] granted by this skill, the amount the damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by becomes 50%.
When Fortina is attacked while she is enhanced with the [Devotion] granted by this skill, the amount the damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by becomes 65%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Let Me Help! The targets of the physical attack become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens The Magic of Happiness. The targets of [Increased ATK] become the 2 allies with the highest ATK.
Strengthens Let Me Help! The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 580% of her ATK.

levels.text:
“If it’s help you need, you can count on me!♪”
Deals 1 physical attack equal to 240% of Shiloh’s ATK to
3 random enemies.

Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, increases both the chance to deal a critical hit and CRIT DMG Boost of the 2 allies with the highest ATK by 15% for 4 turns. If this skill activates in Auto-Battles or Boss Battles, or on the 9th turn and onwards, the increases in the ally targets’ chance to deal a critical hit and CRIT DMG Boost each become 30%.

The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to
530% of her ATK.
“Come here, Anne!” Calling for her furry friend Anne, the two team up to deal 3 physical attacks equal to 320% of Shiloh’s ATK to enemies at random.
The number of physical attacks becomes 5.

The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to
640% of her ATK.

Additionally, if this skill activates on the 9th turn and onwards, the physical attacks’ damage increases by
30% of her ATK for each buff that the ally enhanced with the highest number of buffs is enhanced with (940% of her ATK max).

“My smile is magic...!” The girl who once hid her sadness beneath a smile is here no more— At the start of the turn, this skill increases the ATK of the ally with the highest ATK by 10% for 2 turns. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
Additionally, if this skill activates in Auto-Battles or Boss Battles, or on the 9th turn and onwards, the amount the target’s ATK increases by becomes 50%.
The number of turns of [Increased ATK] becomes 4.

Shiloh’s sunny smile rouses up her allies, filling them with the energy and courage to keep going. At the start of Shiloh’s action phase, this skill grants Shiloh and the
2 allies with the highest ATK 3 buffs that increase their DEF by 50% of the granter’s DEF for 4 turns. These 3 buffs are each treated as different buffs. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, decreases the damage Shiloh takes by 25% (cannot be dispelled).
The decrease in damage Shiloh takes becomes 75%.
